notes.title: Pixel Survivors : Roguelike Release V1.0
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that Pixel Survivors: Roguelike has officially launched its version 1.0! We've worked hard to bring you an exciting and challenging gaming experience, and we hope that you will enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed creating it.

We want to let you know that this could be the final major version of the game. While we will continue to fix any bugs that arise, we feel that there is little left to add to the game. We're proud of what we've accomplished with Pixel Survivors: Roguelike, and we're grateful for all the support you've given us along the way.

In the future I will continue to develop other games, hope everyone will support.

[b]Content v1.0[/b]
- New map: Cemetery
- New character: Cultist
- New skill: Shock Wave
- Rework skill boom
- Rework skill bubble
- Added item upgrade for skull
- UI Rework

[b]Thank you all for playing this game, I will continue to fix the bugs if there are any in the future :D[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where unlocked characters and unlocked achievements were not displayed.

Sorry for this bad experience :(

notes.title: Game Roadmap Update: New Map and Improved Features Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello!

This is a notice about the roadmap for our game.

In the coming time, we will continue to improve and upgrade the player experience by adding new features and improving existing ones.

In the v0.7, we will add a new map to the game and new game play mode, including features such as:

[list]
[*] New map: Cemetery.
[*] New Game Mode
[*] New Challenge
[*] More Achievements
[*] Improved the old maps as well as the bosses in the map.
[*] Added new characters, and new skills along with the map.
[/list]

We appreciate your continued support and are excited to bring these updates to you. Stay tuned for more information on the roadmap in the near future.
